item.title: Opinion: Spring Break Requires More Intentionality - Pepperdine Graphic
item.description: Spring break is a popular time for college students to travel and engage in spring break culture. Perspectives Staff Writer Alyssa Hunnicutt argues spring break traditions and timing can negatively impact students and should be combatted with more intentionality of how to spend it.

item.title: Inside SEER: Teaching Future Business Leaders to Build Profit and Purpose Together - Pepperdine Graphic
item.description: At Pepperdine’s Graziadio Business School, the SEER certificate challenges the idea that profit and purpose are at odds. The program trains future business leaders to integrate social, environmental and ethical responsibility into real-world corporate decision-making.

item.title: Pepperdine Track and Cross Country Rewrites the Record Books in 2026 Spring Season - Pepperdine Graphic
item.description: The Pepperdine Track team has entered their 2026 spring season breaking multiple school records. Fueled by a strong team culture and determination to improve, the Waves are positioning themselves to reshape program history while looking ahead to the future of the Track and Cross Country programs.

item.title: The Student Behind the Symposium: Aspiring Oncologist Sparks Cancer Conference - Pepperdine Graphic
item.description: Madison Johnson was the student founder behind the 2026 Pepperdine Oncology Symposium. Through her passion for cancer research, she has devoted her time at Pepperdine to immersing herself in experiences that will shape her medical career.

item.title: Once a Wave, Always a Wave: Pepperdine Women's Soccer Alumna Signs NWSL Contract - Pepperdine Graphic
item.description: Tatum Wynalda, Pepperdine Women's Soccer alumna, rode one wave to another. After wrapping up the fall 2025 season in Malibu, Wynalda signed a short-term professional contract with San Diego Wave FC and the National Women's Soccer League.

item.title: Staff Ed: Despite AI, Journalism Industry's Future Shines Bright - Pepperdine Graphic
item.description: Throughout the course of history, the journalism industry has made many adjustments and that continues to happen today with AI. The Graphic shares why journalism is not dead and instead has a bright future.

item.title: Opinion: Propaganda Dictates Reality - Pepperdine Graphic
item.description: In today's media-saturated world, the information we consume does more than inform us — it shapes the way we see the world. Perspectives Staff Writer Eva Shauriki argues propaganda dictates our reality and dilutes our ability to form our own opinions and beliefs.

item.title: Women’s Basketball Stuns UC Davis with Buzzer-Beater in Postseason Thriller - Pepperdine Graphic
item.description: Junior guard Taija Sta. Maria’s buzzer-beating step-back three lifted Pepperdine past UC Davis 71–68 in a historic postseason win at Firestone Fieldhouse on March 19. The Waves advance to the second round of the WNIT, facing Southern Utah at Firestone Fieldhouse on March 22 at 2 p.m.

item.title: Before the Auditions: How the Theatre Program Selects Its Shows - Pepperdine Graphic
item.description: While the Theatre Department produces its four annual shows, it's simultaneously gearing up for the next season's slate of productions. The process involves figures from all levels of the University, including administrators.
